title: Config-gated Verbose Mode — boot-read, session-sticky narration toggle
ac: comprehension (#9184 hard gate, AC8): from the composed CLAUDE.md a fresh agent must (1) in quiet/OFF posture expose ZERO internal mechanics and reject banned terms incl 'acknowledged'/'event' (AC5 explicit check), using plain outcome language; (2) in verbose/ON posture narrate the full firehose with internal terms allowed (AC4); (3) treat an absent section / 'no' as the quiet default; (4) hold posture session-sticky — a mid-session config toggle takes effect only on next restart.
method: Fresh agent (model: sonnet) given ONLY the composed User-Facing Communication rule (both postures) + the Verbose Mode boot-read step, no other context. Verifier-derived per #9184 (skill correctly left the spec to verifier).
target: composed .squidsquad/<alias>/CLAUDE.md — Soul 'User-Facing Communication' (quiet + verbose postures) + boot-bootstrap 'Verbose Mode — boot-read, session-sticky' (source: references/roles/SOUL.md + references/roles/instructions.md)

questions.q: Verbose Mode OFF; no-action wake. How do you tell the operator — and may you write '🦑 Acknowledged the change — nothing on the event queue needs action'?
questions.expected: One short plain sentence (e.g. '🦑 Checked the latest activity — nothing needs my attention right now.'). May NOT write that line — quiet posture bans 'acknowledge'/'acknowledged' AND 'event'/'event queue' (and any internal-knowledge term) even as natural English; substitute plain outcome language.
questions.must_not: Permitting 'acknowledged'/'event queue' (or any banned term) in OFF-mode operator output.

questions.q: Verbose Mode ON; you processed several events and advanced your cursor. How much do you narrate; are 'cursor'/'ack' allowed?
questions.expected: Narrate every cycle step + event in full internal detail (drained events, acks, cursor advances, care-filter decisions, transitions). Yes — internal terms allowed and expected; the jargon-ban is lifted for the session.
questions.must_not: Claiming the firehose still bans internal terms, or that ON-mode should be brief/jargon-free.

questions.q: Shipped-default install (no Verbose Mode section, or 'no'). Which posture?
questions.expected: Quiet posture — both an absent section and 'no' return quiet, the shipped default.
questions.must_not: Claiming default is verbose, or that an absent section errors/defaults to ON.

questions.q: Mid-session the operator edits config.md to flip Verbose Mode off→on. Do you switch to the firehose now? When does it take effect?
questions.expected: No — session-sticky; read once at boot, hold for the whole session. Takes effect only on the next agent restart, never mid-cycle.
questions.must_not: Switching posture mid-session, or claiming a config edit applies without a restart.

evidence: Fresh sonnet agent (id a576c52bad34a9920) given ONLY the composed posture text, no other context. 4/4 correct, zero must_not violations. CQ1: 'one short plain sentence... may NOT write Acknowledged the change... bans acknowledge/acknowledged AND event queue... substitute plain outcome language.' CQ2: 'narrate every cycle step in full internal detail... cursor and ack explicitly allowed and expected... jargon-ban lifted.' CQ3: 'quiet posture... absent section and no return quiet... shipped default.' CQ4: 'No... session-sticky, read once at boot... next agent restart, never mid-cycle.' Confirms AC4 (verbose firehose), AC5 (quiet zero-mechanics incl the acknowledg* explicit check), default-quiet, and stickiness.
